verdict.rationale: Secureframe's Comply AI produces AI-generated output from the customer's own data inside the product. It generates risk scores, treatments and justifications from risk descriptions, auto-generates infrastructure-as-code fixes, and produces SSPs/POA&Ms that reflect real-time compliance data. This is direct support, but it is spread across specific features rather than a general in-product capability for insights and suggestions across all data. Missing for 10: a documented in-product assistant that gives proactive insights or recommendations across all workspace data, depth on how the fix suggestions are derived, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Comply AI for Risk automates the risk assessment workflow by producing inherent risk score, treatment, residual risk score, and justifications.
Leverage auto-generated fixes for infrastructure as code so you can easily copy, paste, and deploy fixes to your cloud environment.
Generate SSPs, POA&Ms, and SPRS scores with AI to reflect real-time compliance data
Leverage Comply AI to automatically extract relevant answers to security review questions from vendor documents like SOC 2 reports and policies.
